title: Otto.de Product Scraper
description: Scrape products from Otto.de using JSON-first extraction from search/category pages. The actor paginates by offset, de-duplicates items, and falls back to HTML extraction when needed.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Start from a specific Otto.de search/category URL. If empty, the actor builds a search URL from Search Query.

searchQuery.title: Search Query (if not using Start URL)
searchQuery.description: Search term used when Start URL is empty.

collectDetails.title: Prefer rich records
collectDetails.description: If enabled, the actor prioritizes rich product records (with pricing/rating) and only falls back to basic records when needed.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of products
results_wanted.description: The maximum number of products to collect. Leave empty to collect all available products.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on the number of paginated listing pages to visit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for better results.
